registered_addition_groups.rationale: Reviewed C2 activation recomputes immutable SHA-256 evidence and removes the claimed digest only from a local copied mapping before recomputation. It performs no learning, live affect/drive mutation, persistence, scheduler installation, or authority promotion.

Explicit operator-authorized retention boundary hashes immutable evidence and performs exactly one append through SQLiteShadowStore only after reviewed runtime/source verification. CI use is disposable mechanism evidence; no implicit append, observation-window start, or authority promotion exists.

Operator-only script bootstrap and private-companion filesystem writes keep the database/receipt outside the repository. The command requires an exact clean checkout and cannot fabricate a retained count without the real explicit SQLite append/readback.
Test-only local mapping tamper and temporary-file write exercise fail-closed digest rejection and the real script entrypoint without mutating production state or repository evidence.
